subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should outbound Telegram album support be implemented by porting the open external `send-media-group`/`filePaths` action, by extending the existing `mediaUrls` send path to group eligible media automatically, or by keeping sequential sends as the supported behavior for now?
rationale: The missing capability is source-backed, but the public tool/action shape and fallback semantics affect Telegram UX, message-tool API expectations, and the existing durable send path, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract alone.

options.title: Port album support into existing send surfaces
options.body: Implement `sendMediaGroup` inside the current Telegram plugin send/reply/outbound funnels using existing `mediaUrls` where possible, preserving single-media and non-groupable fallbacks.

options.title: Adopt a separate album action
options.body: Review or port the external PR's explicit `send-media-group` action if maintainers want album sends to be opt-in rather than automatic for multi-media sends.

options.title: Keep sequential sends for now
options.body: Leave current sequential media fan-out as the supported behavior and close or narrow the album request only after a maintainer decides album grouping is out of scope.

recommendation.title: Port album support into existing send surfaces
recommendation.body: Implement `sendMediaGroup` inside the current Telegram plugin send/reply/outbound funnels using existing `mediaUrls` where possible, preserving single-media and non-groupable fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from prior issue review, Telegram/plugin boundary history, and repeated central-file ownership.
